en.headline: Consortium wins first Northern Metropolis large-scale land tender for HK$1.03 billion
en.dek: A six-company group including China Overseas, China Resources Land, Sino Land and JD.com will develop about 10.5 hectares in Hung Shui Kiu, providing around 3,000 flats and a smart logistics centre.
body: The Development Bureau announced on Monday that HSK New Development Limited has been awarded the first large-scale land disposal pilot project in the Northern Metropolis at a tender price of HK$1.03 billion.

The consortium comprises subsidiaries of China Overseas Land and Investment, China Merchants Land, China Resources Land, China Travel Service, JD.com and Sino Land. The roughly 10.5-hectare site in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area includes three residential parcels expected to yield about 3,000 flats averaging 50 square metres, plus an enterprise and technology park site for a smart logistics centre of about 50,950 square metres.

The winning bidder estimated total investment at about HK$16.8 billion and more than 6,000 jobs. It will pay the full land premium within 28 days. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said the partners demonstrated confidence in the Northern Metropolis and its diversified development model. Two bids were received; the successful tender scored higher on both premium and non-premium criteria.

zh.headline: 北部都會區洪水橋大規模土地批出首標 財團以10.3億元中標
zh.dek: 由中海外、華潤置地、信和及京東等六企組成的財團投得約10.5公頃用地，將提供約3,000個住宅單位及智慧物流中心。
body: 發展局周一公布，HSK New Development Limited以10.3億港元投得北部都會區首個大規模土地批出先導項目。
中標財團由中國海外發展、招商局置地、華潤置地、中旅、京東及信和置業的附屬公司組成。洪水橋／厦村新發展區約10.5公頃用地包括三幅住宅用地，預計可提供約3,000個平均面積50平方米的單位，以及一幅企業及科技園用地，用作約50,950平方米的智慧物流中心。
中標者估計整個項目投資約168億港元，可創造逾6,000個就業機會，並選擇在28日內一次過繳付全部地價。發展局局長甯漢豪表示，六家企業的合作顯示對北部都會區及多元發展模式的信心。是次招標共接獲兩份標書，中標者在地價及非地價評分均較高。
